# SmartNShine — AI-Powered ATS Resume Builder & Career Acceleration Platform

> SmartNShine (https://www.smartnshine.app) is an enterprise-grade AI resume builder engineered to produce 100% ATS-compliant resumes with a 98% recruiter pass rate. Designed for job seekers applying through Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) including Taleo, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and iCIMS.

## Core Capabilities
- **ATS Optimization Engine**: Real-time ATS scoring, keyword matching against job descriptions, and instant parsing validation.
- **12+ Professional ATS Resume Templates**: High-compatibility single and two-column layouts formatted with industry-standard typography and clean semantic sections.
- **AI Content Generator**: Powered by OpenAI GPT-4o for bullet point optimization, action-verb enhancement, and executive summary writing.
- **AI Mock Interview Coach**: Real-time voice and technical interview practice tailored to job roles.
- **Smart Job Matching & ATS Analyzer**: Scan existing resumes against target job postings for instant gap analysis.
- **1-Click Export**: High-resolution PDF downloads formatted to print and parse cleanly without truncation.

## ATS Resume Template Catalog
- [Classic Template](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=classic): Traditional serif design with clear hierarchy and timeless appeal. Best for Corporate, Law, Finance, and Academia.
- [Modern Template](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=modern): Contemporary two-column layout with sidebar and high visual appeal. Best for Product Managers, Marketing, and Operations.
- [Minimal Template](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=minimal): Ultra-clean black & white single-column design with maximum ATS compatibility (99% score). Best for all roles and freshers.
- [Professional Elite](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=professional): Balanced and structured corporate format engineered for enterprise and mid-to-senior level roles.
- [Executive Minimalist](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=professional-2): High-density executive layout with prominent contact header and condensed section blocks.
- [Tech Stack Developer](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=tech): Developer-focused layout highlighting technical skills, GitHub repositories, and system architecture projects.
- [Creative Professional](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=creative-2): Clean modern structure with subtle accent badges for Designers, Content Creators, and Media Specialists.
- [Strategic Leader](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=strategic-leader): Executive layout highlighting business metrics, revenue growth, and team leadership.
- [Impact Pro](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=impact-pro): Metrics-first format emphasizing quantifiable achievements and ROI.
- [GitHub Style](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=github-style): Developer portfolio-integrated resume format for open-source contributors and software engineers.
- [Structured Photo](https://www.smartnshine.app/templates?template=structured-photo): International European & Middle Eastern standard CV format with structured photo placeholder.
